content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a project using [product_name] PLC. I want to use five digital inputs to assign five different values to one analog output. Are there suitable function blocks available in [product_name] for this? For example: If INPUT-1 is enabled, I want 2V at AQ1; INPUT-2 enables 4V; INPUT-3 enables 6V; INPUT-4 enables 8V; INPUT-5 enables 10V.
I've attached a possible solution. Please ensure that only one input is active at a time.
Thank you for your help. I will review the solution.

Hello expert, I have a question about this approach. For example: If only INPUT 1 is enabled, I want 2V at AQ1. If INPUT 1 & 2 are enabled, what value should AQ1 provide? What about combinations like INPUT 1,2 & 3; INPUT 1,2,3 & 4; and all five enabled? Is it possible to implement this logic in [product_name]?
If the lower-numbered inputs are always enabled first before higher numbers, you can simplify the logic. See the attached example. Regards, [user_name]

Hello expert, For example: With five inputs, the logic should be—if any one input is active, output 2V; any two active, output 4V; any three active, output 6V; any four active, output 8V; all five active, output 10V.
Hi [user_name], Now you are challenging us! I'll provide an example for you.
Here is a potential solution to your scenario.
Is this a serious question or just a riddle? What practical application does this serve?
Dear [user_name], This is not a joke. I have a project requiring this exact setup and am looking for expert advice. My goal is to control the VFD speed based on the digital inputs.
Hello expert, I know you are experienced. I have a project where I need to control the VFD speed using these digital input combinations, so I'm seeking advice from knowledgeable users.

If you describe the purpose of your project, it would help clarify the three very different input scenarios you're trying to address. Your project may be genuine, but you've received enough responses to overcome my skepticism. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants are exploring methods to configure a [product_name] PLC to generate precise analog outputs in response to various digital input combinations. The main challenge is programming the logic to handle multiple or simultaneous inputs for specific output values. Users are debating whether existing logic blocks provide adequate flexibility for this without complex programming.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] PLC to support a straightforward way to map different digital input combinations to specific analog output values using built-in logic blocks, minimizing the need for complicated programming or custom solutions.
